profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at University of Chicago
profile.summary:
My career objective is to become a specialist in IT industry who has ability to create innovation, effective and powerful large-scale information systems.
Interest: Distributed Systems, Fault-Tolerance, Dependability, Networking, Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
We build the whole technology stack introduced in Gen3.org that is currently the core technology of several big data systems, each of which has 10 petabytes (PB) of scientific data in average, such as Genomic Data Commons, BRAIN Commons, Bionimbus Protected Data Cloud, BloodPac, Kids First, Account, Environmental Data Common. The largest one, Genomic Data Commons, has 25 PB of data.
- Our system are multiple micro-services including the whole technology stack of data submission, data indexing, AuthZ/AuthN services (using OAuth2), ETL, Avro that help researchers sharing and accessing data in worldwide scale. This large-scale system can deploy across different cloud infrastructures such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, IBM to do big data analysis.
- Define our data architecture and lead development team build an ETL process which decouple the dependencies of database schema, the query and aggregation function running in Spark. By using this architecture, data engineer don’t need to rewrite the Spark aggregation function whenever the database schema change or whenever the new queries are needed. This service use Spark, SQOOP, ElasticSearch, Spark Stream.
- Establish the code base for CI/CD process with Jenkins, CodeceptJS. The well-designed architecture and solid code base help QA and Development team to easily implement all testing scenarios with the reusability of basic modules. This framework use Jenkins, CodeceptJS.
- Establish the base structure and choose the technology (React/Redux with GraphQL/Relay to freely
customize front-end independent to back-end API’s syntax) for our front-end web tool called Windmill.
- Build a middleware service to translate GraphQL query (which provides the flexibility to customize front-end) to corresponding ElasticSearch query. The middleware (using GraphQL, ES, Node.js) can support and translate arbitrarily nested queries with different aggregation function.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Research Scientist
positions.description:
We develop the next generation of Software Defined Network (SDN) for Internet Exchange Points (IXP) with a Distributed Control Plane of IXP. That will enable SDN for inter-domain scale networks. The designed system and algorithm are currently used by DE-CIX (Deutscher Commercial Internet Exchange), the largest Internet Exchange Point in term of peak traffic.
Our research result are published in IEEE Magazine of Networking and Symposium on SDN Research
(SOSR)
